Options NATIVE

These apply to this experiment window. Granblue's own Browser Settings still live in the game.

Wiki, About, and Options placement

Where those panels sit relative to the sidebar. The sidebar stays against the game either way.

Chrome theme

Colors the sidebar, Options, and About. Granblue and the wiki keep their own look.

Granblue client

Second Granblue view

The sidebar's Second view opens another Granblue in this window, beside the first. It shares the panel slot with the wiki, so opening one closes the other, and it has its own Back and Reload.

Multiple windows

A whole extra window, separate from the sidebar's Second view. Each one runs its own game, sidebar and panels, so it costs considerably more than a second view does.
